chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “Does one of you not feel ashamed that he cannot endure one day until the night? Indeed, it used to be said: the beginning of fighting is slapping.”
And if a man clung closely to his wife in the month of Ramadan and ejaculated, then freeing a slave would be obligatory upon him.

key_terms.اللَّيْلِ: the night, meaning the time of breaking the fast
key_terms.اللِّطَامُ: slapping; the initial provocation of conflict
key_terms.يَصْبِرَ: to endure with patience and self-restraint

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if intimate contact with one’s wife during Ramadan leads to ejaculation while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith combines an ethical rebuke with a legal ruling related to fasting in Ramadan. It urges restraint and patience during the fast, and states that if intimate contact with one’s wife leads to ejaculation in the month of Ramadan, expiation by freeing a slave is due.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1875 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Does one of you not feel ashamed that they cannot endure (fasting) until the evening? It was said in the past that the beginning of fighting is slapping."
